stories.title: 'Country hick' Kentucky farm owner had terse 6-word response after being offered $26M to build data centers
stories.simple_summary: A Kentucky farm owner turned down a $26 million offer to let a company build data centers (large computer facilities) on his land.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you unless you own rural land that companies want to buy — just a news story about one person's choice.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI shut down a team that was supposed to check if their AI could cause serious problems and figure out how to stop it.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters because it suggests the company may be less careful about safety — but the full impact is hard to know right now.

stories.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
stories.simple_summary: Stripe (a payments company) is buying OpenRouter (an AI company) for over $7 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — it doesn't change what you can do with AI.

stories.title: Why people aren’t buying Mark Zuckerberg’s AI future
stories.simple_summary: Some people don't believe Mark Zuckerberg's ideas about the future of AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about opinions on what AI will become — nothing specific you need to worry about right now.

stories.title: Stripe Clinches Over $7 Billion Deal to Buy AI Firm OpenRouter
stories.simple_summary: Stripe is buying an AI company called OpenRouter for over $7 billion (this is the same story as headline 2).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — it doesn't change what you can do with AI.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO says AI backlash is ‘fundamentally a crisis of trust’
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of Anthropic (an AI company) says people don't trust AI companies and that's the real problem, not that AI is too dangerous.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a business leader defending his company — not something that affects your daily life.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT's app on Mac computers now watches what you click and type so it can learn your habits and suggest things you might want to do next.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT on a Mac, know that it's now tracking your clicks and keystrokes — only turn this on if you're comfortable with that.

stories.title: The U.S. Military Wants A.I. Dominance. Feuds and China May Thwart It.
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. military wants to be the best at AI, but disagreements between people and competition with China could slow that down.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about military strategy and government policy — nothing that affects your daily life or business.

stories.title: Google reportedly taps AMD to design next-generation TPU — hybrid AI ASIC could integrate on-package CPU cores for reinforcement learning
stories.simple_summary: Google is working with AMD to build faster computer chips designed just for AI work.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech engineers and companies — it's about making computers faster behind the scenes.

stories.title: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
stories.simple_summary: AI systems that can act on their own are becoming real, not just science fiction ideas.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an important shift in what AI can do, but the actual impact depends on how companies use it — stay aware but don't panic.

stories.title: Boston-area colleges are looking to make students ‘AI natives’ with new majors
stories.simple_summary: Colleges near Boston are creating new classes and majors focused on teaching students to work with AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have young people in your life considering college, AI skills are becoming more valuable in job markets.

stories.title: National Transport Infrastructure Company deploys AI-based adaptive traffic lights across Israel
stories.simple_summary: Israel is using AI to control traffic lights in a smarter way that adapts to how many cars are on the road.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI can help with everyday problems like traffic — good news if similar systems eventually reach your area.
